scope: Conservative instruction-issue work lower bound; not execution time, speedup, WCET or hardware test
nominal_window_caveat: 40 TBCLK guard margin and submission overhead further reduce this window
nonoverlap: Caller CFG charges each LCR as one group without callee body; separate lambda-root CFG charges only callee groups. Calls to lambda_plan are charged only as one instruction, with body excluded.
multiplicity_evidence: PC_run_fast first interval once and eight candidate intervals, each pf_control_interval step<2. All successful runs complete all nine intervals and 18 roots.
excluded_work: PC_run input, plans, seed, costs, ranks and terminal objective
different_old_bound_not_speedup: Previous 6408 bound covered different relaxed minimum paths; subtracting bounds does not establish runtime improvement.
